WITH bond_elements AS (
  SELECT T1.bond_id,
         CASE WHEN T2.element < T3.element THEN T2.element ELSE T3.element END AS elem1,
         CASE WHEN T2.element < T3.element THEN T3.element ELSE T2.element END AS elem2
  FROM connected AS T1
  JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
  JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
),
combination_counts AS (
  SELECT elem1, elem2, COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS cnt
  FROM bond_elements
  GROUP BY elem1, elem2

max_combination AS (

WITH customer_annual AS (
  SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS annual_consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(annual_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM customer_annual
  GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
  SELECT ca.Segment, AVG(ca.annual_consumption) AS avg_annual
  FROM customer_annual ca
  JOIN segment_min sm ON ca.Segment = sm.Segment AND ca.annual_consumption = sm.min_consumption
  GROUP BY ca.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT avg_annual FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
  (SELECT avg_annual FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM,
  (SELECT avg_annual FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
  (SELECT avg_annual FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM,
  (SELECT avg_annual FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -

  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
